runbooks.summary: Rebuild the v5 point-cloud corpus from the screened mesh bank, with the measured cost and the resume behaviour of every step.
Fit a Robotiq Hand-E so the planner, the guard, the calculator and the driver all model the hand that is bolted on.
The ordered bring-up from a validated config to a first verified pick on a physical cell.
Train the deep grasp generator on a customer's own parts, from a CAD export to a model a cell can select. No weights ship in this repository.
Bring a cell up on a UR model the stack has not run before, including URSim in Docker.
Stand up any UR from a UR3 to a UR10, including what a ur10 cannot do and the CB-series swap nothing upstream can see.
